achievements.name: gage3_15
achievements.title: You Can't Hide
achievements.desc: Kill 25 enemies shooting through walls or objects using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Wooden Body" for the R93 sniper rifle.

achievements.name: gage3_16
achievements.title: Double Kill
achievements.desc: Kill 2 enemies with one bullet 25 times using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Sniper Suppressor" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

achievements.name: gage3_17
achievements.title: Public Enemy No. 1
achievements.desc: Kill 250 enemies using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

achievements.name: kosugi_1
achievements.title: I Will Fade to Dark
achievements.desc: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 4 bags of loot.

achievements.name: kosugi_2
achievements.title: I Will Pass Through Walls
achievements.desc: In the Shadow Raid job, secure at least 6 bags of loot and escape without killing anyone.

achievements.name: kosugi_3
achievements.title: I Will Take With Impunity
achievements.desc: In the Shadow Raid job, secure a piece of every available type of loot, including money, gold, cocaine, artifact, painting, weapons and server.

achievements.name: kosugi_4
achievements.title: I Will Walk Faceless Among Men
achievements.desc: In the Shadow Raid job, secure all 4 pieces of the samurai armor. Unlocks the "Somen Mempo" mask.

achievements.name: kosugi_5
achievements.title: I Am Ninja
achievements.desc: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 16 bags of random loot including all 4 pieces of the samurai armor.

achievements.name: kosugi_6
achievements.title: I Will Die and Die, and Die Again
achievements.desc: Complete the Shadow Raid job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: bigbank_1
achievements.title: It Takes Two to Tango
achievements.desc: In The Big Bank job, hack the correct computer on the first try. Unlocks "The First American" mask, the "Parchment" material, the "Roman" pattern and the "Tactical Grip" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_2
achievements.title: It Takes a Pig to Kill a Pig
achievements.desc: Drop Floyd the pig on top of a law enforcer. Unlocks "The 1st" mask, the "Exhausted" material, the "Ruler" pattern and the "Extended Magazine" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_3
achievements.title: Sweet Sixteen
achievements.desc: Complete The Big Bank job with 16 secured bags. Unlocks "The 16th" mask, the "Clay" material, the "Spartan" pattern and the "Marksman Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_4
achievements.title: 12 Angry Minutes
achievements.desc: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist in under 12 minutes on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Wooden Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_5
achievements.title: Don't Bring the Heat
achievements.desc: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks the "CQB Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_6
achievements.title: Backing Bobblehead Bob
achievements.desc: Bring Bobblehead Bob to the vault. Unlocks "The 18th" mask, the "Gemstone" material, the "God of War" pattern and the "Wooden Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_7
achievements.title: Entrapment
achievements.desc: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist with 12 bags in the default escape with all the lasers active. Unlocks the "CQB Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_8
achievements.title: You Owe Me One
achievements.desc: In the Big Bank job, start the Big Bank job after having spent all 10 favors in Preplanning. Unlocks the "Retro Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: bigbank_9
achievements.title: Don't Forget to Floss
achievements.desc: Complete The Big Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: bigbank_10
achievements.title: Funding Father
achievements.desc: Complete any heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Big Bank" mask each. Unlocks the "Marksman Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

achievements.name: gage4_1
achievements.title: Police Brutality
achievements.desc: Beat a Shield to death using the Telescopic Baton.

achievements.name: gage4_2
achievements.title: Lock, Stock & Eight Smoking Barrels
achievements.desc: Own the Locomotive, Street Sweeper, Reinfeld, Mosconi, Izhma, Raven and M1014 Shotguns. Unlocks the "Flip-up Sight" for the Raven shotgun.

achievements.name: gage4_3
achievements.title: Swing Dancing
achievements.desc: Complete any single day of a heist, killing at least 50 enemies using only your melee weapon.

achievements.name: gage4_4
achievements.title: Seven Eleven
achievements.desc: Get 7 enemy headshot kills within 11 seconds using any shotgun. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the M1014 shotgun, "John" mask, "Explosive" material and "Terror" pattern.

achievements.name: gage4_5
achievements.title: Shotguns 101
achievements.desc: Complete any heist by killing at least 50 enemies and getting 101% accuracy or above using any shotgun. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the M1014 shotgun.

achievements.name: gage4_6
achievements.title: Knock, Knock
achievements.desc: Kill 50 Shields using any shotgun and slug ammo. Unlocks the "Collapsed Stock" for the M1014 shotgun.

achievements.name: gage4_7
achievements.title: Every day I'm Shovelin'
achievements.desc: On the Nightclub job, kill 25 law enforcers using your shovel. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the Raven shotgun.

achievements.name: gage4_8
achievements.title: Clay Pigeon Shooting
achievements.desc: Kill 10 snipers using any shotgun and flechette ammo. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Raven shotgun, "Clint" mask, "Leaf" material and "Monkey Skull" pattern.

achievements.name: gage4_9
achievements.title: Shock and Awe
achievements.desc: Hit 4 enemies simultaneously using any shotgun and HE rounds. Unlocks the "Solid Stock" for the M1014 shotgun.

achievements.name: gage4_10
achievements.title: Bang for the Buck
achievements.desc: Kill 10 Bulldozers using any shotgun and 000 buckshot ammo. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Steven" mask, "Sparks" material and "Chief" pattern.

achievements.name: gage4_11
achievements.title: No Heist for Old Men
achievements.desc: Complete any day of a heist in stealth with a Locomotive 12G shotgun modified with the "Silent Killer Suppressor" equipped. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Rutger" mask, "Banana Peel" material and "Banana" pattern.

achievements.name: gage4_12
achievements.title: Four Monkeys
achievements.desc: In the Rats job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Shotgun Pack" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

achievements.name: gage5_1
achievements.title: Precision Aiming
achievements.desc: Kill 25 Bulldozers using the Gewehr 3 Rifle. Unlocks the "Sniper Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Sniper Stock", "Sniper Grip" and "Sniper Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Precision Stock", "Precision Foregrip", "Precision Grip" and the "DMR Kit" for the Gewehr 3 rifle as well as the "Black Death" mask.

achievements.name: gage5_2
achievements.title: Big Bada Boom
achievements.desc: Kill at least four enemies with one GL40 grenade launcher shot. Unlocks the "Sawed-off" Stock for the GL40 grenade launcher and the "Crow Goblin" mask.

achievements.name: gage5_3
achievements.title: Army of One
achievements.desc: Equip the GL40 grenade launcher, the Locomotive 12G shotgun, and the Improved Combined Tactical Vest. Unlocks the "CQB Foregrip" and "Plastic Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle.

achievements.name: gage5_4
achievements.title: So Many Choices
achievements.desc: Own one of every Gage Assault Pack weapon in the game. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Light Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Plastic Foregrip" and "Assault Kit" for the Gewehr 3 rifle, "Evil" material and "Vicious" pattern.

achievements.name: gage5_5
achievements.title: Artillery Barrage
achievements.desc: Kill 25 enemies at 40 meters or more using only the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the "Wooden Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Pirate Barrel" for the GL40 grenade launcher, "Bone" material and "Muerte" pattern.

achievements.name: gage5_6
achievements.title: Unusual Suspects
achievements.desc: In the Watchdogs job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Assault Pack mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Light Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Tactical Foregrip" for the Gewehr 3 rifle, "Long Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Void" material and "Death" pattern.

achievements.name: gage5_7
achievements.title: Not Today
achievements.desc: Kill a jumping Cloaker using the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the "Wooden Stock", "Retro Grip" and "Wooden Foregrip" for the Gewehr 3 rifle.

achievements.name: gage5_8
achievements.title: Hammertime
achievements.desc: Kill 25 thugs using the Ding Dong breaching tool melee weapon. Unlocks the "Frost" material and "Emperor" pattern.

achievements.name: gage5_9
achievements.title: Rabbit Hunting
achievements.desc: Kill 10 Cloakers using the Gecko 7.62 rifle. Unlocks the "Skeletal Stock", "Fabulous Stock" and "Fabulous Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle as well as the "Volt" mask.

achievements.name: gage5_10
achievements.title: Tour de Clarion
achievements.desc: Kill 200 enemies using the Clarion rifle. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" and "G2 Grip" for the Clarion rifle as well as the "Professor Wrath" mask.

achievements.name: pig_1
achievements.title: Wrong Number
achievements.desc: Complete the Hotline Miami job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: pig_2
achievements.title: Walk Faster
achievements.desc: In day 2 of the Hotline Miami job, reach the Commissar's apartment in under 210 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Rasmus" mask, "Tactical Foregrip" and the "Ergonomic Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Chromescape" material and "Palmtrees" pattern.

achievements.name: pig_3
achievements.title: Do You Like Hurting Other People?
achievements.desc: In the Hotline Miami job, kill 30 thugs with the Baseball Bat. Unlocks the "Dennis" mask, "Solid Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Wooden Grip" for the Cobra submachine gun, "Rubber" material and "Hip to Be Polygon" pattern.

achievements.name: pig_4
achievements.title: Overdose
achievements.desc: Cook and secure six bags of meth on day 1 of the Hotline Miami job. Unlocks the "Graham" mask, "Ghetto Blaster", "Extended Mag" and "Just Bend It" for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun, "Error" material and "Be Somebody" pattern.

achievements.name: pig_5
achievements.title: Sounds of Animals Fighting
achievements.desc: In the Hotline Miami job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Hotline Miami mask each on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Silent Death" and "Folded Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Suppressor" and "No Stock" for the Cobra submachine gun and "Short Barrel" for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun.

achievements.name: pig_7
achievements.title: Phew!
achievements.desc: On day 2 of the Hotline Miami job, save someone in need. Unlocks the "Aubrey" mask, "Ergo Grip", "Extended Mag" and "Unfolded Stock" for the Cobra submachine gun, "Sunset" material and "Doodles" pattern.

achievements.name: squek
achievements.title: State of the Art
achievements.desc: Complete the Art Gallery job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: bulldog_1
achievements.title: Why Don't We Just Use a Spoon?
achievements.desc: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks "Hoxton" as a playable character and the "Nova's Shank" melee weapon.

achievements.name: bulldog_2
achievements.title: No Bars Can Hold Me
achievements.desc: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: bulldog_4
achievements.title: Cavity
achievements.desc: Hurt an enemy using the Nova's Shank melee weapon.

achievements.name: halloween_nightmare_5
achievements.title: Sixth Nightmare
achievements.desc: Complete the Safe House Nightmare job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: eagle_1
achievements.title: Death From Below
achievements.desc: Kill 25 enemies as they rappel using the Nagant sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Constable" mask, the "Silenced Barrel" and the "Long Barrel" for the Nagant sniper rifle, "Gunsmoke" material and "Dazzle" pattern.

achievements.name: eagle_2
achievements.title: Special Operations Execution
achievements.desc: Kill 25 enemies while in stealth using the Trench knife. Unlocks the "Red Bear" mask, "Short Barrel", "Suppressed Barrel", "Short Mag", "Folded Stock", "No Stock", "Solid Stock", "Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel" for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun," Barrel Sight 44", "Damper.L 44 Nozzle" for the Broomstick pistol, "Red Sun" material and "Death Dealer" pattern.

achievements.name: eagle_3
achievements.title: Wind of Change
achievements.desc: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Historical" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Discreet Stock" and "Short Barrel" for the Nagant sniper rifle, "Precision Barrel" for the Broomstick pistol, "Extended Mag" and "Long Barrel" for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun and the "Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel" for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun.

achievements.name: eagle_4
achievements.title: So Uncivilized
achievements.desc: Equip a Broomstick pistol with the Damper.L 44 Nozzle and the Barrel Sight 44. Unlocks the "British Bulldog" mask, "High Capacity Mag" and "Holster Stock" for the Broomstick pistol, "Army Green" material and "Filthy Thirteen" pattern.

achievements.name: eagle_5
achievements.title: Bullet Hell
achievements.desc: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun. Unlocks the "Old Blood and Guts" mask, "Light Barrel" for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun, "Patriot" material and "Captain War" pattern.

achievements.name: deer_1
achievements.title: Vlad's Little Helpers
achievements.desc: Complete the White Xmas job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Mrs. Claus" mask.

achievements.name: deer_2
achievements.title: Stealing Christmas
achievements.desc: Complete the White Xmas job on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Strinch" mask.

achievements.name: deer_3
achievements.title: Cancelling Santa's Christmas
achievements.desc: Complete the White Xmas job on the Very Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Krampus" mask.

achievements.name: deer_4
achievements.title: Claustrophobia
achievements.desc: Complete the White Xmas job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Mechanical Santa" mask.

achievements.name: deer_5
achievements.title: Like Turkeys Voting for an Early Christmas
achievements.desc: Complete the White Xmas job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: deer_6
achievements.title: Riders On the Snowstorm
achievements.desc: In the White Xmas job, complete the heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above while each crew member wears a different "2014 Xmas" mask each. Unlocks the "Almir's Beard" mask.

achievements.name: deer_7
achievements.title: Impossible, It Can't Be. Is It?
achievements.desc: In the White Xmas job, secure the rare Almir's Toast.

achievements.name: bat_1
achievements.title: Devil of a Job
achievements.desc: Complete The Diamond job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: bat_2
achievements.title: Cat Burglar
achievements.desc: In The Diamond job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks "The Cursed One" mask, "Sand" material and "Hieroglyphs" pattern.

achievements.name: bat_3
achievements.title: Culture Vultures
achievements.desc: In The Diamond job, secure 10 bags of additional loot. Unlocks the "Medusa" mask, "Rusting Metal" material and "Runes" pattern.

achievements.name: bat_4
achievements.title: Smoke and Mirrors
achievements.desc: In The Diamond job, steal the Diamond and escape in under 10 minutes. Unlocks the "Pazuzu" mask, "Diamond" material and "Horus" pattern.

achievements.name: bat_5
achievements.title: Honor Among Thieves
achievements.desc: In The Diamond job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Diamond Heist" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

achievements.name: bat_6
achievements.title: Diamonds in the Rough
achievements.desc: In The Diamond job, complete the heist, diamond puzzle and steal the Diamond after the alarm has been triggered on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Anubis" mask, "Mummy Bandages" material and "Hawk Helm" pattern.

achievements.name: frog_1
achievements.title: Tabula Rasa
achievements.desc: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Golden AK.762 rifles and Chicago Typewriter submachine guns. Unlocks a new skill slot.

achievements.name: gorilla_1
achievements.title: Knockout!
achievements.desc: Knock out a Bulldozer using the OVERKILL boxing gloves. Unlocks "The Champ" mask.

achievements.name: cow_1
achievements.title: Derailed
achievements.desc: Complete The Bomb: Forest job on the Normal difficulty or above.

achievements.name: cow_2
achievements.title: A Pine in the Ass
achievements.desc: Complete The Bomb: Forest job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: cow_3
achievements.title: Beaver Team
achievements.desc: In The Bomb: Forest job, cut down all trees within 5 seconds. Unlocks the "Butcher From Hell" mask, "Meat" material and "Pleter" pattern.

achievements.name: cow_4
achievements.title: Pump It Up
achievements.desc: In The Bomb: Forest job, do not let the cops disconnect the water hose while you are using the river water pump. Unlocks the "Tech Lion" mask, "Marble Rock" material and "Lion Game Lion" pattern.

achievements.name: cow_5
achievements.title: Oppressor
achievements.desc: Complete The Bomb: Forest job without letting any civilian flee or die, having at least five civilians in the heist, while escaping with the boat. Unlocks "The Doctor" mask, "Plywood" material and "Caduceus" pattern.

achievements.name: cow_6
achievements.title: Maiden Voyage
achievements.desc: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job on the Normal difficulty or above.

achievements.name: cow_7
achievements.title: Fisherman's Fiend
achievements.desc: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

achievements.name: cow_8
achievements.title: Sneaking With the Fishes
achievements.desc: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job in stealth on the Death Wish difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Lady Butcher" mask, "Rhino" material and "Checker Board" pattern.

achievements.name: cow_9
achievements.title: Breaking Dead
achievements.desc: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, find the meth lab. Unlocks the "Extended Mag" for the LEO pistol.

achievements.name: cow_10
achievements.title: I've Got the Power
achievements.desc: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, don't let the enemies cut the power. Unlocks the "Long Slide" for the LEO pistol.

achievements.name: cow_11
achievements.title: Done in 60 Seconds
achievements.desc: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, open the dock gate in 60 seconds using the keycards. Unlocks the "Custom Slide" for the LEO pistol.

achievements.name: ameno_1
achievements.title: OVE SAW 72000
achievements.desc: In the Nightclub job, complete the heist on any difficulty with each crew member using the OVE 9000 saw as primary and secondary weapons. Unlocks the "THRUST Upper Receiver", "THRUST Lower Receiver" and "Long Ergo Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family.

achievements.name: ameno_2
achievements.title: Hey Mr. DJ
achievements.desc: In the Nightclub job, have 12 hostages or more on the dance floor when you escape. Unlocks the "Aluminum Grip" for the AK weapon family, the "Aluminum Foregrip" for the Krinkov submachine gun and the "LW Upper Receiver" for the CAR weapon family.

achievements.name: ameno_3
achievements.title: $1.8M Speedrun
achievements.desc: In the Mallcrasher job, loot $1,800,000 in loose cash within 50 seconds of starting the heist. The heist must be played on the OVERKILL difficulty. Unlocks the "Scope Mount" and "PBS Suppressor" for the AK weapon family, "Alfred" mask, "Dawn" material and "Dinosaur Skull" pattern.

achievements.name: ameno_4
achievements.title: Here Comes the Pain Train
achievements.desc: In the Firestarter job, complete the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above, with all days done in loud and with a crew of 4 players using unmodified "AK Rifle" rifles and "PARA" submachine guns. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AK.762" and the "Low Drag Magazine" for the AK weapon family, "Timothy" mask, "Prehistoric" material and "Dinosaur Stripes" pattern.

achievements.name: ameno_5
achievements.title: The Wolf Lures You to Your Grave
achievements.desc: In the Art Gallery job, kill two of the patrolling guards in stealth in the bathroom. Unlocks the "E.M.O. Foregrip" and the "OVAL Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family and the "Aftermarket Shorty" for the PARA submachine gun.

achievements.name: ameno_6
achievements.title: The Turtle Always Wins
achievements.desc: In the Art Gallery job, complete the heist in stealth within 4 minutes with each crew member wearing the Improved Combined Tactical Vest and no Armor Bag deployable equipped. Unlocks the "Classic Stock" for the AK weapon family, "2 Piece Stock" for the AK and CAR weapon families, "Pachy" mask, "Fossil" material and "Prehistoric Predator" pattern.

achievements.name: ameno_7
achievements.title: Private Party
achievements.desc: In the Jewelry store job, don't let the cops enter the jewelry store until the van comes back on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AMR-16" and the "L5 Magazine" for the CAR weapon family, "Vincent" mask, "Feathers" material and "Dinosaur Scars" pattern.

achievements.name: ameno_8
achievements.title: The Collector
achievements.desc: Kill 100 cops using only weapons from the AK or CAR weapon families. Unlocks the "Keymod Rail", the "Crabs Rail" and the "Modern Barrel" for the AK weapon family.

achievements.desc: Complete the Rats job with you and your four man crew having Combined Tactical Vests, Vulcan Miniguns, HRL-7 Rocket Launchers and "General OVERKILL" masks equipped on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

achievements.name: ovk_2

achievements.desc: In the Shadow Raid job, complete the heist in stealth while having the Vulcan Minigun and HRL-7 Rocket Launcher equipped.

achievements.title: Oh, That's How You Do It
achievements.desc: Fire the Vulcan Minigun for 25 seconds without reloading or letting go of the trigger.

achievements.title: We Are Rockstars On This Job
achievements.desc: Complete the Watchdogs job with each crew member using no skills, wielding the AMCAR Rifle and Chimano 88 Pistol on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

achievements.name: ovk_5
achievements.title: Reputation Beyond Reproach

achievements.desc: You are immune to criticism. You are simply THE best. Everything your hands get to touch and create is GENIUS. This achievement is unique and is meant to be given to no one but you. Everyone else has a fake copy of it.

achievements.name: ENGINEER
achievements.title: Trust me, I'm an engineer
achievements.desc: Someone else's pass works just like someone else's diploma: it allows you to connect to engineering terminals and boast that you're a hacker while simply touching "Yes"/"No" on monitors.

achievements.name: FIREASS
achievements.title: Butthurt
achievements.desc: The ignition of natural gas can cause not only a heated argument on some online forum but also a 20% increase in the flight speed with accelerators.

achievements.name: AGILITY
achievements.title: Dodger
achievements.desc: When your life hangs in the balance, oxygen is left for one breath, the world is in danger, and death and suffering surround you — fly through all the rings!

achievements.name: SURVE
achievements.title: Almost served
achievements.desc: When you jogged for three days in a row, prepared yourself mentally to serve in the army, boasted that you were going to be a paratrooper, and then suddenly failed all medical tests — can this be considered as "almost served", or not?

achievements.name: CLEANER
achievements.title: Vacuum cleaner
achievements.desc: The vacuum cleaner can not only help to clean the apartment quickly but can also rush through space and time like a jet motorbike. So convenient!

achievements.name: DESTROYER
achievements.title: Destructor
achievements.desc: Labor turned ape into a... more muscular ape. You have unique destruction skills, now your delicate workmanship with the handy scrapper will cause more damage to everything you touch with it.

achievements.name: DIRTY
achievements.title: Pollutionist
achievements.desc: "It's a bad thing to destroy the whole garbage collecting infrastructure for selfish purposes," so my mother says. Although who cares, anyway? Isn't that a cleaner robot in the distance?

achievements.name: DRIVER
achievements.title: Driver
achievements.desc: The dead people flying around are highly unlikely to say "wow!" to your highly polished brand new ZAZ but it's still nice to enjoy the ride with the wind... Or without it...

achievements.name: ELECTRONIC
achievements.title: Electronic
achievements.desc: If you mess around with electricity for a long time, you might get immune to it. Probably. But it's better not to try it.

achievements.name: END2CHAPTER
achievements.title: Complete Chapter 2
achievements.desc: Completing the second chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the third one. That's how it is.

achievements.name: END3CHAPTER
achievements.title: Complete Chapter 3
achievements.desc: Completing the third chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the second one. That's how it is.

achievements.name: HAKER
achievements.title: Hacker
achievements.desc: It would be an awful thing to open coffins if we weren't talking about their back panel containing the control panel. And since it's all about the control panel, then all is well, and you can proceed to open it.

achievements.name: INDUSTRIALHELPER
achievements.title: A contributor to the industry
achievements.desc: Congratulations! If you didn't cheat, then you are helping the industry to develop! In some way, not necessarily in the right one.

achievements.name: MUTAGEN
achievements.title: Mutagen
achievements.desc: Scanning the dead product of genetic engineering will help the spacesuit to replenish its library of useless images. And it might be possible to sell these pictures to the newspapers if need be.

achievements.name: PSYCHO
achievements.title: Psychiatrist
achievements.desc: It's very easy to determine a person's mental disorder by the color of his spacesuit. Especially if you're a charlatan. A real professional will try to find and add all the other possible signs of the illness.

achievements.name: REBELIOUS
achievements.title: A rebel
achievements.desc: You are a rebel at heart, a rebel by nature, and a rebel by horoscope. Down with other people's advice! Stick your fingers in…

achievements.name: RIFLEMAN
achievements.title: Sharpshooter
achievements.desc: It may seem that making a hundred or two shots is not so difficult, but when each shot is worth the cost of a whole space station, it's a completely different story.

achievements.name: ROUGE
achievements.title: Bandit
achievements.desc: Attacking a security robot is a felony, even if no one saw you do it. On the other hand, it is still a felony, so there is nothing good about it.

achievements.name: SHEPHERD
achievements.title: Shepherd
achievements.desc: It's really easy to herd cows in space: just pile them up in a heap and don't touch them until the rescuers come.

achievements.name: TOTHEEMBRASE
achievements.title: Heroic deed
achievements.desc: There's no point in heroically covering a barrel of a beam weapon with your chest. You can, if you like, but in this case, it's just not necessary. If you really want to do it, don't forget to turn the weapon off first.

achievements.name: COFFINCOUNTER
achievements.title: Coffin Counter
achievements.desc: Finding and counting dead coffin robots is an interesting and extremely educational activity, although it's absolutely useless. If only there would be the living ones…

achievements.name: PERSISTENT
achievements.title: A Persistent One
achievements.desc: If you press any broken button persistently, something will definitely happen. Maybe the button will break, or maybe even your finger.

achievements.name: AWERSOME
achievements.title: The breathtaking!
achievements.desc: Believing in yourself and never giving up, even when everything is useless and scripted, is breathtaking! No, you're breathtaking!

achievements.name: COFFINKILLER
achievements.title: Undertaker
achievements.desc: Living coffins are no joke. Some may think that such a situation isn't a big deal, but in reality, a dead thing being alive makes it a zombie, a zombie is a bad thing, a bad thing is a problem, a problem is serious, serious equals an investigator and an investigator equals a life sentence. In the end, do you really want to go to prison?

achievements.name: COWKILLER
achievements.title: A menace to cows
achievements.desc: Properly disposing of synthetic animal corpses, you can save humanity from dangerous diseases and the fertile soil from senseless pollution. You can also enjoy magnificent gore effects but that's not what matters.

achievements.name: FASTSHOOTER
achievements.title: Quick draw
achievements.desc: Being the fastest is a real achievement! It's a real mastery! It deserves some respect! You hear, honey?! IT'S AN ACHIEVEMENT! =(

achievements.name: GUNMASTER
achievements.title: Machine gunner
achievements.desc: Shooting a machine gun is easy. Hitting a target with it is harder. It's even harder to hit a target with the shuttle's plasma guns when the shuttle isn't designed for them.

achievements.name: MAP
achievements.title: Cartographer
achievements.desc: Being able to orientate yourself is an extremely important skill for any traveler. Don't forget to mark the landmarks that are visible from afar, keep an eye on the moss on tree trunks, and don't forget about the North star and your compass. Especially, if you're not in space.

achievements.name: OWNHEAD
achievements.title: Think with your own head
achievements.desc: One can listen to other people's advice forever, but it's much more valuable to think with your own head. You learn best from your own mistakes, as someone said... Or maybe they didn't.

achievements.name: RIGHTCHOISE
achievements.title: The right choice
achievements.desc: Sometimes, among a thousand of options, only one is the right one. It's amazing how you managed to identify it. The greatest minds will break their heads over solving this puzzle.

achievements.name: TOUCHER
achievements.title: Toucher
achievements.desc: A man's palms say more than the backs of his hands, elbows, or navel. If you want to appear a strong and hard-working man in the eyes of others, you can rub your hands to get calluses that will brutally scratch other people's hands when you shake them.

achievements.name: VUYAERIST
achievements.title: Voyeur
achievements.desc: Spying on people is indecent, and spying on dead people is doubly indecent. Probably. The dictionary didn't say anything about it under the word "voyeur".

achievements.name: WASTED
achievements.title: Wasted!
achievements.desc: Not everyone can save the galaxy, but saving it by just sitting on the couch is beyond comprehension. Keep it up!

achievements.name: CONNECTION
achievements.title: Airlock master
achievements.desc: They teach astronauts how to dock to airlocks even before teaching them how to use the space toilet. Missing the toilet is unpleasant, but not fatal — missing the airlock is a problem.

achievements.name: ALLREPAIRS
achievements.title: Competitor
achievements.desc: With all due respect to the work of repair robots, they are useless competitors that consume resources. These guys are not subject to reprogramming and will fix everything that gets in their manipulators: shuttles, the liner's debris, vehicles, killer coffins…

achievements.name: ALLTURRETS
achievements.title: Pew-pew!
achievements.desc: It turns out that if you bomb a liner, the anti-asteroid turrets go crazy. They go crazy by themselves, without any killer coffins' help. That's right. In any case, space will be much safer without them.

achievements.name: COFFINBASE
achievements.title: Saboteur
achievements.desc: A quick and unexpected raid on the enemy's infrastructure is very effective, brave, and only a real space fighter is worthy of doing that. We can only hope that the coffins were really building these strange stations, and not destroying them.

achievements.name: COFFINGENERAL
achievements.title: Sir, no sir!
achievements.desc: Someone always has to control an army, even if it's an army of crazy coffins. A coffin squadron without a general is just a bunch of stupid meat containers, and a coffin squadron with a general is also just a bunch of stupid meat containers, but with a general. That's a fact!

achievements.name: ICEBALLS
achievements.title: Ice breaker
achievements.desc: It would be more correct to call this reward "An Ice-Shooter", but it sounds weird. In any case, the fewer unattended blocks of ice of questionable quality in space, the fewer people will be poisoned by poor-quality water in the future. Well, that's sanitary!

achievements.name: MANYCRASH
achievements.title: Careful driver
achievements.desc: Either a very drunk, or a very meticulous pilot who wants to get a special achievement in his career would wipe all the asteroids in the area with a bottom of a space shuttle. It's up to you to decide, which one you want to be.

achievements.name: MANYSHOTS
achievements.title: Big machine gun
achievements.desc: It's fun to shoot with a blaster, but to shoot with big military spaceship blasters is a lot more fun. However, there is some bad news and some good news. The bad news is that shooting military weapons is prohibited without a license. The good news is that everyone who could have inspected this has already died.

achievements.name: REPAIREMENT
achievements.title: Auto repair shop
achievements.desc: A spring squeak, the smell of fresh engine oil, the noise of an angle grinder, and the fervent swearing of a mechanic — you can't find all this in outer space, and you never will. But what you can find is the creaking of your joints, the smell of fresh sweat, and the sound of blood in your ears. Space is a lousy place.

achievements.name: ideal_song

achievements.name: astro_book

achievements.desc: Gave the Necronomicon to Snake. Hope nobody uses it as cookbook!

achievements.name: fix_bridge

achievements.name: tech_r2

achievements.desc: Collected 3000 red points. Ok. Now that's impressive.

achievements.desc: Bought your first land in the Village. By cheating a sick and helpless old man.

achievements.desc: Built the tavern. Horadric wishes you were dead now.

achievements.name: dlc_stories_tavern_q_20
achievements.title: Good skull
achievements.desc: Your tavern's quality is 20! Wow!

achievements.name: dlc_stories_tavern_q_40
achievements.title: Well-known skull
achievements.desc: Your tavern's quality is 40! Double Wow!

achievements.name: dlc_stories_tavern_q_80
achievements.title: Epic skull
achievements.desc: Your tavern's quality is 80! Ultra Wow!

achievements.name: dlc_stories_barman
achievements.title: Employee of the month
achievements.desc: Yorick became your bartender. For no salary. Slavery? No, he's made of wood!

achievements.name: dlc_stories_first_stand_up
achievements.title: Open mic
achievements.desc: Put on your first Comedy Show. The guests laughed on command, so everything went good.

achievements.title: Locking up the sun
achievements.desc: Put on your first concert. Ms. Charm's fans fell into ecstasy and a brawl broke out.

achievements.desc: Organized your first rat race. The winning rat got a giant piece of cheese, choked on it, and died.

achievements.title: Best party
achievements.desc: Threw an excellent alco-party. It's time to open the local drunk tank.

achievements.name: dlc_stories_good_stand_up
achievements.title: Best mic
achievements.desc: Put on an excellent Comedy Show. It can't be -- the guests didn't have to be commanded to laugh!

achievements.name: dlc_stories_good_sharmel_song
achievements.title: Best concert
achievements.desc: Put on an excellent concert. Ms. Charm received a marriage proposal from each male spectator.

achievements.name: dlc_stories_good_rat_race
achievements.title: Best race
achievements.desc: Organized an excellent rat race. Two guests lost everything and drowned themselves.

achievements.name: dlc_stories_15_events

achievements.name: dlc_stories_cut_scene_1

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s5

achievements.desc: A vampire is terrorizing the villagers? Solution: an army of carnivorous bees.

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s10
achievements.title: The face of the enemy
achievements.desc: Exposed the vampire. Time to play Van Helsing!

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s12
achievements.title: To stop an Ancient Curse
achievements.desc: Alaric convinced you to help. Refusal would have been dangerous to your health.

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s15_1

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s15_2

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s18

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s33
achievements.title: Awkward interrogation
achievements.desc: Interrogated vampire Carl, leaving Carl greatly enlightened.

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_s40
achievements.title: Lesser evil
achievements.desc: Lady Beatrice made you an offer you can't refuse. Unless you decide to refuse.

achievements.desc: It's your last chance to join the workers and peasants. To be more specific, the donkeys and rats.

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_d3
achievements.title: Cook of Revolution
achievements.desc: You've helped the revolutionaries. Let's spread donkey communism across the world!

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_d6
achievements.title: Writer of Revolution
achievements.desc: You've helped the revolutionaries again. They'll be hard pressed to hang you as a "dirty exploiter".

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_d10
achievements.title: Ideologist of Revolution
achievements.desc: You've helped revolutionaries a third time. Who is next in line for General Secretary?

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_cook

achievements.name: dlc_refugees_tanner

achievements.name: dlc_souls_s_s_4_3

achievements.name: dlc_souls_s_s_6a

achievements.name: dlc_souls_s_s_6b_2

achievements.desc: It belongs in the church.

achievements.name: dlc_souls_s_s_16_1

achievements.name: dlc_souls_s_s_41
